description: This Java class `ChainAuthHandler` manages a chain of authentication handlers, allowing sequential attempts to extract credentials from a given execution context. It supports appending handlers and processing credentials through a chain until success or exhaustion.

classes.name: ChainAuthHandler
classes.description: A handler that chains multiple authentication handlers for sequential credential extraction.

methods.name: ChainAuthHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing an empty list of auth handlers.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds an `AuthHandler` to the chain for processing.

methods.name: parseCredentials
methods.description: Initiates credential parsing through the chain of handlers asynchronously.

methods.name: parseCredentials (private)
methods.description: Recursively attempts to extract credentials from the context via each handler in the chain.
